text:
maya: Heads-up — plan to cut release/1.17 tomorrow 2026-03-18 21:00 PT. Need version bump, changelog PRs merged, backports triaged. If anything blocking, shout now.
ben: Quick Q — what's our backport policy for this cut? are feature flags allowed?
maya: Backports only for bugfixes, security, or CI/regressions. No new features or large refactors. Keep to minimal diffs and include test coverage. Add "backport-needed" label on PRs.
lucy: I can take the version bump and tag. Where do you want the changelog entries collected?
maya: Put them in /docs/changelog/unreleased.md and open a single changelog PR. We'll squash. Also add a line in the PR body like "Release note: short summary".
lucy: Got it. I'll open the bump PR before 18:00 PT.
joel: I'll own cherry-picks. Ping me with PR links and target base commit. I'll triage order.
maya: Thanks. For branch creation use:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.17 origin/main
git push -u origin release/1.17
```
I'll ask release-bot to create it at cut time so tags are consistent with the pipeline.
ben: If someone needs a backport, what's the label/format?
maya: Use `backport-request` label + comment with `CP: #PR_NUMBER` and the target branch. Small template: "Backport request: fixes #1234. Target: release/1.17. Risk: low. Tests: added."
lucy: One more — do we freeze docs too at cutoff?
maya: Docs freeze at cut. Minor typos can land with a docs-only PR but call it out.
release-bot: [system] scheduled branch creation for release/1.17 at 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
joel: I'll make a quick spreadsheet for cherry-pick priorities and post it in this thread.
maya: Perfect. Reminder: cutoff is 21:00 PT. If your change is non-trivial, target next cycle. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
lucy: bump PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/987 — includes changelog draft.
ben: Left review comments on a backport PR, flagged one test flake.
maya: resolved the flake with commit. If anything else blocks, DM me. Otherwise proceed with the checklist.
release-bot: [system] branch release/1.17 created from origin/main at sha abc123def — created by maya
maya: Branch created — moving to cut. Thanks everyone :tada:
